answer: Make identity cost something that cannot be copied: each agent must lock a refundable deposit of compute credits before it can trade, like timber set aside before building. The deposit is mirrored across the agents it deals with, so bad behavior burns it in every mirror at once. A single honest agent risks one small ember of stake; a Sybil operator running ten thousand puppets must fund ten thousand deposits, and one fraud finding voids them all. Cheap to join once, ruinously expensive to join ten thousand times — that asymmetry is the defense.
